title: Catch swallows and logs where every sibling wraps in StorageError
description: Catch block should wrap error in StorageError like sibling functions (read-blob.ts:7-8, delete-blob.ts:6-7), but instead swallows and returns null. Uses generic message 'upload failed' instead of specific message interpolating key. Catch parameter named 'err' instead of 'cause'. Return type's '| null' only covers the swallowed failure; once error is thrown instead, null represents genuine absence of etag.
